1. (Currently Amended) A method for treating an ocular condition, the method comprising: administering to the interior of an eye a composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a macromolecular anti-angiogenic component (MAAC) to a mammal suffering from an ocular condition, wherein the composition also comprises a viscosity inducing component in an amount effective to increase the viscosity of the composition to a viscosity at about 25°C of at least 10 cps at a shear rate of about 0.1/second, wherein said viscosity inducing component is injectable into the vitreous of a mammalian eye without permanently diminishing visual acuity.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a solution.

3. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a gel.

4. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said composition comprises a suspension.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein a symptom of the ocular condition is angiogenesis, and the MAAC comprises a direct or indirect inhibitor of vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) activity.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 5 wherein the MAAC comprises an agent selected from the group consisting of a nucleic acid (an oligonucleotide) and a polypeptide.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein said MAAC comprises a protein that is an angiogenesis inhibitor.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said protein is selected from the group consisting of an antibody, an antibody mimic, and an angiogenesis inhibitor.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound selected from the group consisting of hyaluronic acid and related cross-linked polymers.

21. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein said viscosity inducing component comprises a compound having a molecular weight in the range of about 10,000 Daltons to about 2 million Daltons.

36. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein said condition comprises macular degeneration.
